title: Durable Agent Jobs
tagline: Persist job states and reject stale worker completions.
summary: Build a local job ledger with explicit transitions, versioned claims, lease expiry and atomic snapshot files. The store assumes one process owns the ledger; production multi-process coordination needs a transactional database or lock service.
usefulFor: Persist job states and reject stale worker completions.
Offline experiments with explicit failure cases and limits
youWillBuild: Build a local job ledger with explicit transitions, versioned claims, lease expiry and atomic snapshot files. The store assumes one process owns the ledger; production multi-process coordination needs a transactional database or lock service.

stages.title: Create jobs with stable identity
stages.summary: Accept a bounded identifier and start every job in queued state with version zero.

stages.title: Claim with a lease and version
stages.summary: Only queued work can be claimed.

stages.title: Finish or reclaim expired work
stages.summary: Finish succeeds only for the current running version before its lease expires.

stages.title: Write and recover atomic snapshots
stages.summary: Validate every record and reject duplicate IDs before writing.
